title: Lead Estimator
description:
About the role

For more than 60 years, Complex has been known for delivering award winning construction projects across the built environment.


Our skillful execution of quality projects is an expression of our personal and professional commitment to connecting and enhancing communities.


We are looking for a Lead Estimator, this role will provide support and technical advice to our estimating team, deliver accurate, competitive, and well-documented cost estimates for civil & construction projects, while also providing oversight and tender coordination to the estimating team.


The Lead Estimator is a critical role that remains hands-on in the preparation of tenders while contributing to pricing strategy, subcontractor engagement, and achieving tendering milestones.


Key responsibilities

  • Prepare accurate and competitive cost estimates, budgets, and scopes of work for civil construction tenders
  • Review tender documentation (drawings, specifications, RFTs, contracts) to confirm scope, risks, and opportunities
  • Conduct and/or coordinate site inspections to assess conditions and identify construction risks
  • Perform and review quantity take-offs using Benchmark, Revu, and Excel
  • Prepare detailed cost build-ups, subcontractor comparisons, and pricing reconciliations
  • Analyse historical project data to support pricing accuracy and continuous improvement
  • Promote consistent estimating methodologies, tools, and documentation standards
  • Maintain effective working relationships with key subcontractors and suppliers

About you

  • Minimum 5 years' experience in commercial construction / civil infrastructure estimating
  • Demonstrated experience preparing and leading complex civil tenders
  • Strong understanding of civil, building and construction methodologies, contract review and risk identification, and cost planning and pricing strategy
  • Proven ability to mentor and support junior and mid-level estimators
  • High-level competency in Benchmark, Bluebeam Revu, Microsoft Excel, and Microsoft Project (Intermediate level)
  • Ability to manage multiple tenders and competing deadlines
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Well-developed interpersonal, negotiation, and organisational skills


If this sounds like you please APPLY reach out to Ebony Ison, ebony.ison@complexco.com.au

Description

Job Summary:

The BESS Project Scheduler is responsible for developing, maintaining, and analyzing detailed project schedules for Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) projects. This role plays a critical part in ensuring projects are delivered on time by providing accurate schedule forecasts, identifying risks, and supporting project teams with data-driven insights across engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, and energization phases. This role requires a strong leader that will take ownership of driving accurate and up to date scheduling across multiple projects as well as taking initiative to drive process improvements where there is an opportunity to improve.

Job Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with Project Managers, Construction Managers, OEMs, and subcontractors to validate logic, durations, and sequencing
  • Perform critical path analysis, float analysis, and schedule risk assessments
  • Track project progress and update schedules using actuals, forecasts, and recovery plans
  • Identify schedule impacts related to procurement delays, permitting, weather, interconnection, or change orders
  • Prepare schedule narratives, look-ahead schedules, and progress reports for internal and external stakeholders
  • Support claims, change management, and time-impact analyses as required
  • Ensure schedules align with contract milestones, EPC agreements, and owner requirements
  • Maintain schedule standards, templates, and best practices across the portfolio
  • Other duties as assigned

Requirements

  • Bachelorâs degree in construction management, Engineering, Project Management, or related field (or equivalent experience)
  • 5+ years of project scheduling experience in utility-scale energy, power generation, or heavy civil construction
  • Direct experience supporting BESS, solar, wind, or substation projects
  • Advanced proficiency in Primavera P6 (required)
  • Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Project and Excel
  • Strong understanding of construction sequencing, procurement lead times, and commissioning activities

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with EPC contracts and utility-scale energy storage projects
  • Knowledge of battery OEM workflows (manufacturing, FAT, shipping, commissioning)
  • Familiarity with Power BI or other reporting/analytics tools
  • Experience supporting schedule recovery plans and delay analysis
  • Experience developing resource-loaded and cost-loaded schedules
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to present schedule data clearly to non-technical stakeholders

Work Environment/Physical Requirements

  • Combination of office, remote, and active construction site environments
  • Ability to work extended hours during critical project phases
  • Working in all weather conditions
  • Must be able to lift more than 50 lbs.
  • May require overtime, nights, or weekends based on project needs

Pre-Employment Requirements

Candidates must successfully complete a background check and drug screening prior to hiring. This role is considered safety-sensitive and may be subject to ongoing drug and testing in compliance with company policy and regulatory requirements.

Location: Location specific; travel up to 50%

Reed Recruitment are delighted to be recruiting for one of the UKâs leading multi-discipline Civil Engineering and Building contractors, for a Civils Estimator. This role offers a fantastic opportunity for career development and progression within a dynamic team.


Day-to-day of the role:

  • Provide a comprehensive estimating service, controlling either an assigned project or a portfolio of projects.

title: Working Student Supply Planning (all genders)
description:
In this role, you will support our Supply Planning team in translating demand forecasts into feasible production and replenishment plans. You will help ensure that materials are available, production schedules remain on track, and key stakeholders stay aligned.

This position offers a great opportunity to gain hands-on experience in supply and production planning within a fast-growing FMCG environment, while working closely with experienced planners and cross-functional teams.

What you'll do

  • Support the creation and maintenance of production and supply schedules in alignment with demand forecasts

  • Assist in coordinating with Demand Planning and Purchasing to help ensure timely availability of raw materials and components

  • Help track production performance versus plan and support the team in identifying variances or risks

  • Prepare reports, analyses, and planning data in Excel or ERP systems to support decision-making

  • Contribute to cross-functional coordination by supporting communication with operations, purchasing, and marketing teams

  • Assist with ad-hoc analyses, data checks, and process improvements within the planning team

     

Your profile

 

  • Currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s program in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Industrial Engineering, or a related field, ideally with a focus on operations, production, or planning

  • Availability: Ideally available for around 20 hours per week and able to commit for at least 8 months, so you can grow into the role and gain meaningful hands-on experience

  • Strong analytical mindset and genuine interest in how supply chains, production flows, and forecasting processes work in practice

  • Confident working with data and Excel; experience with ERP or planning tools is a strong plus

  • Structured, detail-oriented, and reliable working style with the ability to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines

  • Proactive, curious, and eager to learn in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment

  • Fluent in English; German is a plus

Nice to have / strong advantage:

  • First practical experience (internship working student role) in Supply Planning or Production Planning

  • Exposure to FMCG, food, supplements, cosmetics, or other high-volume production environments

What we offer

  • An attractive discount on our full product range – from essential oils to vitamins and minerals

  • Ownership and plenty of room for new initiatives, with the opportunity to contribute your expertise and turn your own ideas into action

  • Hands-on experience in a dynamic Operations environment and insight into the operational and strategic sides of Suppy Planning

  • Opportunities to contribute to real projects and make an impact

  • Inviting office spaces with a wide selection of organic teas and superfoods from around the world to taste and enjoy

  • We love to celebrate together! Regular tea and office parties, Christmas and summer events, and numerous influencer events, such as Women’s Day

 
 

Sunday Natural emerged from a long-standing passion and research in the fields of health, healing, and personal growth. The lack of natural, high-quality products on the market was the original motivation for founding Sunday Natural in 2013. We aim to produce the products we ourselves would love to buy – as natural as possible, absolutely pure, free from any additives, and of the highest quality. In a strategic partnership with CVC, Sunday Natural is now one of Germany's most renowned quality manufacturers, with its own research and development department in Berlin. For the continuous improvement of our products, we collaborate with selected research institutes, scientists, therapists, farmers, and professional associations.

We take our ecological responsibility very seriously: that’s why the majority of our product range is vegan. We also take an innovative approach to packaging: most of our products are packaged in glass, making them almost entirely recyclable.

Our diverse team in Berlin consists of over 400 employees from more than 45 nationalities and continues to grow – but at a sustainable pace. Our goal is to foster a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive work environment with a diverse group of motivated, talented, and visionary team members.

We highly value equality of opportunity and inclusivity, and we would like to particularly encourage women and candidates from under-represented backgrounds to apply, even if you don’t match with 100% of the requirements.

title: Founder’s Associate
description:
🏢 Who we are

A team from Germany with the vision to make advanced network security accessible for everyone

We are a software company developing an open source zero-trust network security platform that is both easy to use and affordable for teams of all sizes and budgets. Our mission is grounded in a simple yet powerful belief: secure private networking is a fundamental right of every modern company.

Since our launch on GitHub in 2021, we have gained trust among thousands of companies seeking secure and seamless solutions for connecting remote employees and infrastructure. By replacing traditional centralized VPNs, NetBird has become a trusted choice for modern network security, connecting today hundreds of thousands of users and machines worldwide. Our open source, community-driven approach has been a key driver of our success. We listen to our users, and their input helps us make network security better for everyone.

Want to see what we're working on? Check out our GitHub repo at https://github.com/netbirdio/netbird or https://netbird.io/knowledge-hub

✏️ What you will do

As Founder's Associate at NetBird, you'll work directly with our founders and Chief of Staff as a sparring partner and execution engine on the topics that matter most to the company. This is a high-trust, high-ownership role for someone who wants to see, and shape, how a fast-growing open source startup is built, from strategy to day-to-day execution.

Specifically, you will:

  • Own strategic projects across growth, product, operations, and fundraising end to end, from first analysis to shipped result

  • Help grow the team, from running recruiting operations to winning exceptional people for NetBird

  • Research markets, competitors, and customer needs to identify new opportunities and risks before they become obvious

  • Drive cross-team initiatives and keep Product, Growth, and Engineering aligned on critical company milestones

  • Design and improve the internal processes that keep a scaling company running, and take ownership of whatever matters most right now, from testing new GTM ideas to unblocking the founders

🔎 What we are looking for

We're looking for an exceptional generalist: highly motivated, analytical, and hands-on, with the ambition to help build and scale a tech startup from the inside.

What you bring

  • A track record of excellence and real ownership, for example through top academic results from a top tier university or internships in high-caliber startups, venture capital, investment banking, or strategy consulting

  • You're highly structured, organized, and able to drive multiple topics in parallel without losing your eye for detail

  • You enjoy working with data, building models, and turning insights into action, but also have a hands-on mentality

  • You're comfortable taking a vague problem, defining it, and driving it to a result

🌟 What makes you a great fit

These are the values we work by as a team, and what they mean for this role:

  • Own the outcome: Small team, real scope. You take problems end to end and ship something that works today instead of polishing a plan for weeks.

  • Default to candor: Direct, kind, and specific, whether you're challenging a colleague's assumption or receiving feedback yourself. The best argument wins.

  • Stay close to the user: You don't have to be an engineer, but you're genuinely curious about our product and the open source community behind it.

😌 What's in for you

We know that happy and supported team members build the best products. That's why we offer:

  • Competitive salary and equity: everyone at NetBird owns a piece of what we're building

  • Close collaboration with our co-founders: work with them day to day and learn how a startup is really built

  • High impact: your projects directly shape NetBird's trajectory

  • Hybrid setup: a centrally located Berlin office with flexibility for remote days

  • The essentials done well: team lunches, team events, health and fitness programs (e.g., Wellpass), and dinner on us when you're working late

title: Projektentwickler - Ostdeutschland (m/w/d)
description:
Q ENERGYs Ziel ist es, eine nachhaltige Welt mit grüner Energie zu ermöglichen. Unsere Unternehmenswerte - Verantwortung, Partnerschaft, Inklusive and "Changemaker" - sind die Grundlage für unser Handeln. Als Europas führender Anbieter von grünen Energielösungen sind wir ein vertrauenswürdiger Partner für das gesamte Spektrum der erneuerbaren Energien. Unser Ziel ist es, die Welt mit Solar-, Wind- und Hybridkraftwerken, innovativen Speicherlösungen und visionären grünen Wasserstoffprojekten neu zu definieren. 

Begleite uns auf dieser spannenden Reise, um unseren Planeten nachhaltig zu verändern.

Für unser Team suchen wir eine engagierte Projektmanager (m/w/d), die die erfolgreiche Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Wind-, PV- und BESS-Projekten von der ersten Standortidee bis zur Genehmigungsreife und Übergabe in die Realisierung verantwortet.

 

Ziel der Rolle ist es, wirtschaftlich attraktive, genehmigungsfähige und technisch umsetzbare Projekte zu identifizieren und gezielt voranzutreiben. Dabei übernimmst Du die ganzheitliche Steuerung der Projekte sowie die Koordination aller relevanten internen und externen Stakeholder und stellst die Einhaltung von Zeit-, Kosten-, Qualitäts- und Entwicklungszielen sicher.

Ihre Aufgaben

  • Projektakquise und Standortentwicklung: Identifikation, Bewertung und Sicherung geeigneter Standorte und Flächen für Wind-, PV- und BESS-Projekte einschließlich Machbarkeitsanalysen und Flächensicherung.
  • Projektentwicklung und Genehmigung: Entwicklung und Optimierung von Projekten, Steuerung der Genehmigungs- und Planungsverfahren sowie Koordination von Gutachtern, Planern, Behörden und weiteren Projektpartnern.
  • Technische und wirtschaftliche Entwicklung: Bewertung von Netzanschlussmöglichkeiten, Projektlayouts und Wirtschaftlichkeit sowie Steuerung von Kosten, Terminen, Risiken und Projektbudgets.
  • Stakeholder- und Projektmanagement: Aufbau und Pflege von Beziehungen zu Grundstückseigentümern, Kommunen, Behörden, Netzbetreibern und Geschäftspartnern sowie Koordination der internen und externen Projektbeteiligten.
  • Projektabschluss und Übergabe: Vorbereitung der Projekte für Finanzierung, Vermarktung, Verkauf oder Übergabe in die Bau- und Realisierungsphase.

Requirements

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium oder vergleichbare Qualifikation im technischen oder energiewirtschaftlichen Umfeld.
  • Berufserfahrung in der Projektentwicklung im Bereich erneuerbare Energien, der Netzintegration oder der Netzanschlussplanung.
  • Gute Kenntnisse regulatorischer- und Grundkenntnisse netztechnischer Anforderungen.
  • Analytische, strukturierte und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise.
  • Sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und starkes Schnittstellenmanagement.
  • Deutschkenntnisse auf professionellem Niveau sowie fortgeschrittene Englischkenntnisse werden vorausgesetzt.

Benefits

  • Flexibler Arbeitsort: Du hast die Möglichkeit, remote von zu Hause aus zu arbeiten. Zusätzlich steht dir unser modernes und nachhaltiges Büro in Berlin-Südkreuz zur Verfügung, das eine gute Anbindung und eine angenehme Arbeitsumgebung bietet.
  • IT-Ausstattung: Wir stellen dir einen Laptop, Monitor, Kopfhörer und, falls erforderlich, ein Diensthandy zur Verfügung.
  • Work-Life-Balance: Deine Zeit ist wertvoll! Gestalte deine Arbeitszeiten flexibel, damit du persönliche Termine wahrnehmen, früher ins Wochenende starten oder einfach das Leben besser mit der Arbeit in Einklang bringen kannst. Du entscheidest.
  • Spendit Card: Monatlich 50 € zusätzlich zum Gehalt, die du für dein tägliches Mittagessen nutzen oder unbegrenzt ansparen kannst.
  • Großzügige Urlaubsregelung: Genieße 31 Urlaubstage pro Jahr, um dich zu erholen, neue Energie zu tanken und die Welt zu entdecken.
  • Onboarding: Mit einem strukturierten Onboarding-Prozess sorgen wir für einen reibungslosen Start und begleiten dich von Tag eins an, damit du dich gut aufgehoben fühlst.
  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge: Wir leisten einen monatlichen Beitrag von 13,29 € zu deiner Altersvorsorge.
  • Versicherungsschutz: Unfall- und Lebensversicherung sind inklusive – für deine Sicherheit und ein gutes Gefühl, sowohl im Job als auch privat.
  • Mitarbeiterrabatte: Über unser Corporate Benefits-Programm erhältst du exklusive Rabatte auf zahlreiche Marken und Produkte.
  • Firmenwagen: Falls du berechtigt bist und dein Job es erfordert, steht dir ein Firmenwagen zur Verfügung.

title: Senior AI Architect & Consultant (m/w/d)
description:
Wer wir sind

Die Mayflower GmbH baut Individualsoftware mit Fokus auf Generative AI – seit 1998 inhabergeführt. 

Wir bringen komplette AI-Infrastrukturen in Produktion: Model-Serving, Agent-Gateways, Chat und Voice – direkt in der Umgebung des Kunden. Dich erwartet ein agiles Arbeitsumfeld mit echter Verantwortung und flachen Strukturen – Entscheidungen triffst Du selbst, statt sie durch Freigabeschleifen zu schieben.

Wir suchen Dich – jemanden, der AI-Systeme nicht nur konzipiert, sondern ihren Weg in die Produktion aktiv mitverantwortet. Von der Architekturberatung auf C-Level bis zum Produktivbetrieb: Du entwirfst die Lösung und bringst sie mit dem Team in den echten Einsatz.


Was dich erwartet

  • Anspruchsvolle Projekte mit LLMs, Agentic RAG und AI-Agent-Frameworks (z. B. LangGraph, PydanticAI, Mastra oder OpenAI Agents SDK) – inklusive Deep-Agent-Architekturen. Du baust Evaluation-Pipelines und Observability (Logging/Tracing mit LangSmith, Langfuse o. Ä.) auf und arbeitest mit modernem MLOps-Stack sowie Vector Databases.
  • Du entwirfst Lösungsarchitekturen für komplexe Kundenvorhaben – mit Security, Compliance, Skalierbarkeit und Datenschutz im Hinterkopf – von der ersten Skizze im Gespräch bis zur konkreten Roadmap.
  • Gemeinsam im Team führst Du Deep-Dive-Calls und Workshops mit Kunden durch und bringst sie in die nächste Projektphase.
  • Du begleitest die Anbahnung neuer Projekte und unterstützt unser Team im Pre-Sales mit technischer Glaubwürdigkeit.
  • Du kommunizierst souverän auf C-Level – Du verstehst ökonomische Ziele, sprichst die Sprache von Entscheider:innen und verbindest technische Exzellenz mit Business-Impact.
  • Der Schwerpunkt Deiner Rolle liegt mit etwa 50 % in Kundenprojekten, in intensiven Phasen auch darüber. Den übrigen Teil Deiner Zeit investierst Du in Pre-Sales-Gespräche und Workshops, die Du vorbereitest und durchführst, sowie in die strategische Unterstützung von Geschäftsführung und Sales.
  • Konferenzen, Community-Events, Fachbeiträge: Präsenz ist ein Plus, keine Bedingung. Wichtig ist uns nur, dass Du bereit bist, Dich fachlich zu zeigen.
  • Du reist 4–8 Tage im Monat zu Kunden und Kolleg:innen – Reisebereitschaft innerhalb Deutschlands, bei Bedarf auch in Österreich und der Schweiz, ist Teil der Rolle.


Das solltest du mitbringen

  • Langjährige Erfahrung als Architekt:in oder Senior Engineer, idealerweise bei einem Dienstleister oder in der IT-Beratung.
  • Projekterfahrung mit Agentic-AI-Implementierungen, die über Prototypen hinausgeht: LangChain, LangGraph und Deep Agents im echten Einsatz – oder vergleichbare Tiefe im TypeScript-Umfeld (Mastra) bzw. im Microsoft-Ökosystem (Semantic Kernel / Microsoft Agent Framework, Azure AI Foundry). Vector Databases und MLOps sind ein Plus.
  • Die Kompetenz, Kunden AI-Konzepte und Architekturen anschaulich und praxisnah zu vermitteln.
  • Du kannst Lösungen im Kundengespräch skizzieren und überzeugend vertreten – Storytelling und Präsenz sind Deine Stärken.
  • Du begegnest C-Level auf gleicher Ebene – Du verstehst, welche Aspekte Entscheider:innen bewegen und wie Du technische Konzepte in wirtschaftliche Relevanz übersetzt.
  • Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch (C1+) und konversationssicheres Englisch.


Das haben wir zu bieten

  • Kompetitive Vergütung: Attraktives, marktgerechtes Gehaltspaket, das zu Deiner Erfahrung und Kompetenz passt.
  • Echte Produktionsverantwortung: Deine Systeme laufen produktiv bei großen Unternehmensgruppen - nicht in der Demo-Umgebung.
  • Gute Software bauen: Hier wird echter Wert auf Code- und Softwarequalität gelegt.
  • Kein 08/15: Abwechslung durch unterschiedliche Branchen, Use Cases und Technologien - vom GPU-Cluster bis zum Voice-Agenten.
  • Kundenbeziehung auf Augenhöhe: Wir pflegen eine ehrliche und vertrauensvolle Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kunden.
  • Mache einen Unterschied: Viel Verantwortung, großer Gestaltungsspielraum - in einem Mittelständler, in dem dein Beitrag den wirtschaftlichen Erfolg direkt beeinflusst.
  • Lerne immer dazu: Weiterbildung (intern und extern), Training-on-the-job und regelmäßige Weiterentwicklungs- und Gehaltsgespräche.
  • Wie arbeiten selbstorganisiert:  Wir geben dir den Freiraum, den Rahmen für gute Arbeit selbst mitzugestalten – im Team wie beim Kunden.
  • Werde berühmt: Eine technische Redaktion unterstützt dich beim Schreiben und Publizieren, sodass du als Experte nach außen sichtbar wirst.
  • Du musst nicht die klügste Person im Raum sein: Echte Sparring-Partner, die deine Ideen gemeinsam mit dir auf die Probe stellen und weiterentwickeln.
  • Schalte einfach ab: Niemand erwartet Erreichbarkeit nach Feierabend, im Urlaub oder trotz Krankmeldung. Viele Überstunden sind bei uns nicht üblich.
  • Gut für die Psyche: Ersthelfer psychische Gesundheit, Employee Assistance Programm und ein offener Umgang mit mentaler Gesundheit.
  • Freiraum für dein Privatleben: Flexible Arbeitszeiten, bis zu vier Tage Homeoffice die Woche, spontan einen Tag frei, Arbeiten aus dem EU-Ausland, Sabbatical oder 4 Wochen Urlaub am Stück.
  • Bring dein +1 mit: Brave Bürohunde oder Kinder an schulfreien Werktagen sind herzlich willkommen.
  • Finanzielle Benefits: Regelmäßige Teamevents, Wellpass, 30 Tage Urlaub, Kindergartenzuschuss, Deutsche Dienstrad.

description:
Intro

Wir machen Unternehmensfinanzierung einfacher: digital, schnell und mit zunehmend intelligenten Lösungen. Mehr als 7.500 Unternehmerinnen und Unternehmer nutzen fulfin bereits.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Tech Teams suchen zum sofortigen Start einen Senior Engineer. Du wirst Teil eines kleinen, erfahrenen Teams und übernimmst weitreichende Verantwortung für geschäftskritische Lösungen.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Du entwickelst und betreibst zuverlässige, wartbare Software.
  • Du übernimmst wichtige Projekte von der Problemdefinition bis zur Umsetzung und zum laufenden Betrieb.
  • Du hinterfragst Annahmen, erkennst Risiken und übersetzt geschäftliche und produktbezogene Anforderungen in wirkungsvolle, pragmatische technische Lösungen.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Produktteam, der Geschäftsführung sowie internen und externen Stakeholdern zusammen.
  • Du unterstützt andere Entwickler und hilfst dabei, unsere technischen Standards und Arbeitsweisen weiterzuentwickeln.


Dein Profil

Anforderungen:

  • Du kommunizierst ausgezeichnet auf Englisch und kannst komplexe Themen technischen wie nicht-technischen Zielgruppen klar vermitteln.
  • Du zeigst Eigeninitiative, denkst kritisch, setzt klare Prioritäten und treibst Themen eigenverantwortlich bis zum Ergebnis voran. Dabei bist du neugierig und motiviert, dir fehlendes Wissen selbstständig anzueignen.
  • Du verfügst über ein solides Fundament in der Softwareentwicklung und praktische Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und im Betrieb von Produktivsystemen.
  • Du kannst und möchtest überwiegend vor Ort in unserem Münchner Büro arbeiten.
Von Vorteil:
  • Du verfügst über professionelle Deutschkenntnisse.
  • Erfahrung in FinTech, Finanzdienstleistungen oder einem anderen regulierten Umfeld.
  • Kenntnisse in TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, AWS, Docker, Node.js, React, GraphQL, Serverless- oder ereignisgesteuerten Architekturen.
  • Erfahrung in einem kleinen Team mit breitem individuellem Verantwortungsbereich.
Du musst nicht jede genannte Technologie oder Branche kennen. Lernbereitschaft, Verantwortungsübernahme und klare Kommunikation sind uns wichtiger als ein perfekt passender Lebenslauf.

  • Kostenlose Getränke: Kaffee, Wasser und weitere Getränke stehen dir im Office kostenlos zur Verfügung.

title: Founding Recruiter (m/w/d)
description:
Build Recruiting. Build Navius.

Navius startet in eine neue Phase.

Wir wollen nicht die nächste Recruiting-Agentur aufbauen, die möglichst viele Profile verschickt, Prozesse verwaltet und Aktivität mit Erfolg verwechselt.

Wir wollen Recruiting so machen, wie wir es selbst für richtig halten:

persönlich, verbindlich, datenbasiert und mit einem hohen Anspruch an die Qualität unserer Arbeit.

Dafür suchen wir einen erfahrenen Recruiter oder eine erfahrene Recruiterin, der oder die nicht einfach eine bestehende Rolle übernimmt, sondern Recruiting bei Navius mit aufbaut.

Als Founding Recruiter übernimmst du von Anfang an Verantwortung für eigene Mandate und Kunden. Gleichzeitig gestaltest du mit uns Prozesse, Technologie und die Art, wie wir künftig Recruiting machen.

Ergebnis vor Aktivität ist dabei eines unserer zentralen Prinzipien. Arbeit beginnt bei uns mit einem klaren Ziel und endet mit einem messbaren Ergebnis.

Aufgaben

Du verantwortest deine Recruiting-Mandate eigenständig von der Auftragsklärung bis zur erfolgreichen Besetzung.

Dabei wirst du

  • unsere Kunden direkt beraten und Anforderungen gemeinsam mit ihnen challengen

  • individuelle Such- und Sourcingstrategien entwickeln

  • Kandidaten und Kandidatinnen identifizieren und direkt ansprechen

  • Screenings und Interviews führen

  • Kandidaten fundiert bewerten und unseren Kunden vorstellen

  • mehrere Recruiting-Projekte parallel steuern

  • eng mit Hiring Managern und Entscheidern zusammenarbeiten

  • langfristige Kundenbeziehungen aufbauen und weiterentwickeln

  • unsere Recruiting-Prozesse von Anfang an mitgestalten

  • KI, Automatisierung und moderne Recruiting-Technologie dort einsetzen, wo sie unsere Arbeit tatsächlich besser machen

Eine erfolgreiche Besetzung ist für uns nicht das Ende. Gute Arbeit zeigt sich auch daran, dass Kunden bei ihrem nächsten Hiring-Bedarf wieder mit Navius arbeiten wollen.

Und weil du zu den ersten Menschen gehörst, die Navius mit aufbauen, geht deine Rolle über Delivery hinaus. Du kannst mitentscheiden, wie Recruiting bei Navius künftig funktioniert.

Qualifikation

Eine perfekte Checkliste gibt es bei uns nicht. Recruiting-Erfahrung brauchst du trotzdem.

Du passt gut zu uns, wenn du

  • bereits mehrere Jahre eigenständig im Recruiting gearbeitet hast
  • Active Sourcing, Interviews und die Steuerung kompletter Recruiting-Prozesse kennst
  • Kunden beraten kannst und auch widersprichst, wenn du fachlich anderer Meinung bist
  • Verantwortung übernimmst und Entscheidungen selbstständig treffen kannst
  • strukturiert und ergebnisorientiert arbeitest
  • einen hohen Qualitätsanspruch hast, ohne dich in Perfektion zu verlieren
  • neugierig auf Technologie und KI bist und neue Wege ausprobierst
  • Lust auf Aufbau statt ausschließlich auf fertige Strukturen hast
  • du kommunizierst sicher und professionell auf Deutsch und Englisch, sowohl im Gespräch als auch schriftlich

Uns interessiert dabei nicht nur, was du bisher gemacht hast, sondern wie du denkst und arbeitest.

Klarheit ist uns wichtiger als kurzfristige Harmonie. Verantwortung ist uns wichtiger als Ausreden. Unterschiedliche Perspektiven und konstruktiver Widerspruch gehören ausdrücklich zu unserer Zusammenarbeit.

Benefits

Work where it works for you

Wir kontrollieren keine Anwesenheit. Arbeite dort, wo du produktiv bist – remote, im Coworking Space oder gemeinsam mit uns vor Ort. Coworking-Möglichkeiten stehen dir deutschlandweit zur Verfügung.

Vertrauen statt Micromanagement

Wir definieren Ziele und Ergebnisse. Deinen Kalender wollen wir nicht kontrollieren.

Echter Gestaltungsspielraum

Du kommst nicht in eine fertige Recruiting-Organisation. Du baust sie mit auf und kannst Prozesse, Tools und Arbeitsweisen aktiv mitgestalten.

Moderne Ausstattung

Gute Hardware, professionelle Recruiting-Systeme, LinkedIn und die Tools, die du brauchst, um deinen Job richtig gut zu machen.

KI gehört zum Job

Nicht als Buzzword. Wir wollen Technologie konsequent dort einsetzen, wo sie uns schneller oder besser macht und mehr Zeit für die Arbeit schafft, bei der Menschen den Unterschied machen.

Direkter Kundenzugang

Kein Account Manager zwischen dir und dem Kunden. Du arbeitest direkt mit Hiring Managern und Entscheidern.

Perspektive

Mit Navius soll auch unser Recruiting-Team wachsen. Als Founding Recruiter kannst du perspektivisch Verantwortung für dieses Team übernehmen.

Gehalt

45.000–50.000 Euro brutto pro Jahr plus variable Vergütung.

Unser variables Modell belohnt nicht die schnellste Besetzung, sondern gute Arbeit, langfristige Kundenbeziehungen und daraus entstehendes Folgegeschäft.

Wir respektieren Fokus. Meetings brauchen einen Zweck, Fokuszeiten werden respektiert und Nein-Sagen ist ausdrücklich erwünscht.

Wir suchen keinen Recruiter und keine Recruiterin, um einfach einen freien Platz in einem bestehenden Organigramm zu besetzen.

Wir suchen jemanden, der Lust darauf hat, früh dabei zu sein und Recruiting bei Navius mit aufzubauen.

Unsere fünf Prinzipien geben dabei ziemlich gut wieder, was du von uns erwarten kannst – und was wir auch von dir erwarten:

Ergebnis vor Aktivität.
Klarheit vor Harmonie.
Verantwortung vor Ausreden.
Respekt vor Zeit und Fokus.
Vielfalt als Leistungsfaktor.

Wenn du damit nichts anfangen kannst, werden wir wahrscheinlich nicht zusammenpassen.

Wenn du beim Lesen dagegen mehrfach gedacht hast „Genau so möchte ich arbeiten“, dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen.

Vergiss das perfekte Anschreiben.

Schick uns deinen CV oder dein LinkedIn-Profil und ein paar Sätze dazu, warum du Lust hast, als Founding Recruiter Recruiting bei Navius mit aufzubauen.

Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

About the role

Every contact that reaches a customer support agent, and every credit issued to customers, represents a defect somewhere in our system. This role exists to help find those defects, trace them to their source, and work with the teams responsible to eliminate them at a systemic level.

This is a high impact senior program management role within the EMEA Customer Experience organisation, reporting to the Director of Defect Elimination and Customer Experience. The Senior Program Manager is accountable for turning customer experience signals from Wolt and/or Deliveroo markets into clear, actionable insight, and for driving the resulting fixes through to resolution with partner teams.

What you'll be doing

  • You will own the delivery of the defect elimination program across EMEA, including application of the defect driver taxonomy to identify where defect rate concentrates, and where customer outcomes are worst. You will build a clear, prioritised list of issues for partner teams to work through.
  • You will represent the voice of the customer in the rooms where decisions get made about your markets. That means preparing and presenting data in product reviews, weekly/monthly business reviews and planning sessions, so the cost of poor customer experience is concrete and attributable, and so partner teams understand what is being asked of them and why.
  • You will build working relationships with partner teams in engineering, marketplace operations, courier operations, and finance, and you will track the fixes they commit to through to completion. You will feed results back into the program so everyone can see what worked, and to ensure defects are eliminated for good.
  • You will maintain and improve the data infrastructure and reporting that underpins this work, ensuring customer experience insights are credible, available and actionable.

Our humble expectations

  • The right person for this role has spent time inside a large-scale customer experience or operations function, and has direct experience translating customer defects through identification, root cause analysis and resolution. They are comfortable working with imperfect data, and they know how to build a credible case when the evidence is directional rather than conclusive.
  • Strong analytical instincts are essential. This person needs to know what questions to ask of the data and whether the answers make sense. Prior exposure to a successful voice of the customer (VoC) program is critical.
  • There is a meaningful cross-functional dimension to the role. This person will spend real time getting other teams to prioritise work that benefits the customer but may compete with other priorities. That requires good judgement, clear communication, and the ability to build trust quickly with people outside their reporting line.
  • The role also requires the ability to drive results in a dynamic and ambiguous landscape. The right person will combine introducing structure and rigor, while being agile and responsive to changing priorities and emerging issues. 

This is a high impact and high visibility role, with the opportunity to interact with stakeholders and teams across the full customer lifecycle. The role will also span across 40 EMEA Roo & Wolt markets, meaning there is an opportunity to drive financial and customer experience results at scale.

Next steps

You will first meet with our Talent Acquisition team to understand role and company fit. Then, you will meet with the Hiring Manager who will talk through your relevant experience and ask you competency based questions that assess your suitability for the role. The third stage is an assignment, where you will be given a business problem to think through, and present back to the team. If successful, there may be a final conversation with a more senior stakeholder. Throughout all stages, you will have plenty of opportunities to ask any questions about the role, team or company.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Data
description:
We are building the world's decision infrastructure: the strategic twin of every industrial organization for complex combinatorial problems. We unlocked what wasn't possible before: mapping reality with its levers and constraints into a computer, then running n-dimensional optimization on critical value-chain decisions. We help Europe stay strong and the German Mittelstand make good decisions between market shifts, orders, machines and people.

Founded by Dana (CEO) and Erik (CTO) from RWTH research, backed by a €2.8M round led by Vorwerk Ventures, with customers live on our optimization models.

We move fast. We care. No patience for problems left unsolved.

Your mission

Hi, I'm Erik, CTO of Circonomit. This ad is specific on purpose: you should be able to tell from it whether this is your job.

We build decision infrastructure for industrial companies: our customers model their production, with its capacities, costs and constraints, and we compute the answer to "what should we do?" before the decision is made.

Your mission: scale our data platform for multiple customers and domains. Customer data arrives in many formats from many sources, ERP exports included; it has to land in our system consistently, stay manageable at millions of records, and be fast to query when models and results are on-screen. The product is a data-heavy web app with a math-heavy backend (Python, TypeScript, Solid.js, Postgres, on Cloudflare): your center of gravity is data and infrastructure, but you touch the whole stack. We are looking for a system thinker who wants to shape the architecture.

We will not sugarcoat it: short deadlines, real workload, and a platform that grows while customers already run on it.

What you'll own

  • The data platform end to end: ingestion, storage, and the query paths that keep millions of records fast on screen. You design it, you build it, you run it in production.
  • The platform layer, directly with the CTO: infrastructure, deployments, and the path to production for the whole team.
  • Performance and correctness work in the optimization engine, together with our research engineers.
  • Your features from first line to production: nobody hands you a ticket and waits.

How we work

Small team, short lines of communication, no layers. You own your features end to end: you build them, you ship them to production yourself, you run them.

Feedback runs both ways, and it runs continuously, in daily work and in weekly one-on-ones. We talk as equals. We communicate proactively and flag it early when something isn't working out. Saying no is part of the job.

We like this work, and you'll notice. We review each other's code, and we like being together in the Cologne office, because the fastest conversations still happen in a room.

Requirements

  • 5+ years building production backend or data-intensive systems.
  • Strong Python and solid TypeScript, with the appetite to work in both daily.
  • Analytics-data experience: real SQL depth, plus any of Parquet/Arrow/DuckDB/dbt/warehouse internals.
  • Production PostgreSQL (multi-tenant, migrations, performance).
  • Data pipelines over heterogeneous sources (ERP exports, Excel, CSV) onto object storage (S3 or comparable), built to keep working as customers and formats grow.
  • Distributed systems and API design: typical failure modes, HTTP/auth/caching, sane versioning and error behavior.
  • Engineering craft: design patterns, CI/CD pipelines you set up yourself, prototypes you can throw away.
  • You have worked in a team, not mostly alone, and you know from experience which agile practices carry their weight.
  • You have experience working with Linear, Jira, or a similar project management tool.
  • You communicate proactively, too much rather than too little, and you organize yourself and your work.
  • German at C1 or better, and fluent English. Team life runs in German; code and docs are English.
  • NRW-based (Cologne office), optionally Munich, Stuttgart, Berlin area or else willing to work hybrid. Open to find a way if we fit.

Nice to have: a substantial migration you carried out end to end (system, stack, or data) · telemetry and observability · Cloudflare or comparable serverless infrastructure · frontend experience, ideally with Solid.js or another reactive framework · optimization/OR exposure · manufacturing or ERP data experience.

You are structured and biased for action, and you have shown you play to win wherever life has put you so far.

This role is not for you if you want a clearly defined box, or work handed to you in tickets. We are a small team, pre-Series A: structures and processes are still being built, by us and by you. Priorities shift with customers, and some weeks a deadline bends the plan.

Benefits

  • Impact. You see your results in the real world, fast. The problems are concrete (production plans, capacities, logistics), and customers can measure in euros what your work changed.
  • Ownership. What you build, you ship, and you own it once it runs. No layers between you and production, no approval chain that turns your decision into someone else's.
  • The people next to you. You work directly with the CTO on the platform layer, and with the math and OR team on the optimization engine.
  • Shaping. The processes are still forming, and whoever shows up with a better way of doing things gets to install it. This is a place for system thinkers: the interesting part is seeing how the pieces fit and where they will break. The company is early, and your scope will grow with it.
  • Feedback speed. You will know where you stand. We say things out loud, we adjust, and we expect the same from you.
  • High stakes. Competitive salary and relevant room in the equity package (VSOP) to match your contribution and your career development.
  • The basics. Hardware of your choice · AI tooling budget · sports membership · Deutschland-Ticket.

Process: first conversation, 20 minutes, with me or with the engineer who owns our frontend. Second conversation with the two of us together; this is where the technical questions get deep. Then a hands-on challenge, about three hours of your time, followed by a 45-minute walkthrough where you explain your solution and the decisions behind it. Finally, the team: online first, then in person at the office. Both sides decide. Two to three weeks end to end, and you hear back within days after each step. Before you decide, ask us to put you on a call with someone who will tell you the good, the bad and the ugly.

To apply: skip the cover letter. Tell us about your favorite system you have built, and one decision in it you would reverse today.

"Hustle the day, analyze at night, reinforce something outstanding." Period.

  • Du wirst eingearbeitet, bevor du loslegst. Die ersten Wochen läufst du mit, schaust zu und übernimmst Schritt für Schritt. Erst wenn du sicher bist, bekommst du eigene Objekte — nicht am ersten Tag.
  • Du lernst den Markt an der schnellsten Stelle kennen. Vermietung ist der Bereich, in dem man am schnellsten versteht, wie Immobilien funktionieren: warum sich eine Wohnung in drei Tagen vermietet und die im selben Haus in sechs Wochen nicht.
  • Du sprichst selbst mit Kunden. Interessenten, Mieter, Eigentümer. Du bist vor Ort das Gesicht von LPE und nicht die Stimme im Hintergrund.
  • Du hast einen festen Ansprechpartner. Ein Makler aus dem Team begleitet dich, gibt dir Rückmeldung und übernimmt, wenn ein Fall komplizierter wird. Fragen zu stellen ist bei uns kein Zeichen von Schwäche, sondern Teil des Jobs.
  • Wir entwickeln unsere Makler selbst. Wer bei uns lernt und liefert, hat nach dem Studium eine Perspektive.
  • Du arbeitest mit Software, die es sonst nicht gibt. Unser eigenes System lpeOS bildet Prozesse ab, für die andere Unternehmen noch mit Excel-Listen und Papierordnern arbeiten.


Was dich bei uns erwartet – Deine Aufgaben

  • Du organisierst die Vermarktung einer Einheit. Fototermin mit unseren Fotografen abstimmen und begleiten, Exposé erstellen, Inserat veröffentlichen und aktuell halten. Beim Exposé unterstützt dich unser Marketing.
  • Du kümmerst dich um die Interessenten. Anfragen sichten und vorqualifizieren, Termine koordinieren, Besichtigungen durchführen und nachfassen. Auch dann, wenn auf ein Objekt vierzig Anfragen kommen.
  • Du bereitest die Mieterauswahl vor. Unterlagen auf Vollständigkeit prüfen, Bonitätsnachweise sichten und deine Einschätzung zu den Bewerbern abgeben. Die finale Entscheidung trefft ihr gemeinsam.
  • Du unterstützt bei Abnahmen und Übergaben: Protokolle vorbereiten, Zählerstände erfassen, Mängel dokumentieren, Schlüssel übergeben.
  • Du hältst die Daten sauber. Jeder Kontakt, jeder Termin, jeder Status im System. Das klingt unspektakulär und ist die Grundlage dafür, dass bei uns nichts verloren geht.
  • Du arbeitest den Maklern zu. Termine vorbereiten, Objektunterlagen zusammenstellen, Korrespondenz übernehmen, bei Interessenten und Dienstleistern nachfassen. Vieles davon lernst du dabei nebenbei — weil du siehst, wie ein erfahrener Makler einen Fall aufbaut.
  • Du übernimmst Backoffice-Aufgaben. Stammdaten pflegen, Unterlagen digitalisieren und ablegen, Prozesse dokumentieren. Wie viel das ist, hängt von der Auslastung ab — planbar besprechen wir das jede Woche.


Was du mitbringen solltest

  • Du gehst offen auf Menschen zu. Eine Besichtigung mit acht fremden Leuten zu führen, muss dir liegen. Perfekt sein musst du dabei am Anfang nicht.
  • Du hast ein Gespür für Menschen — oder willst es entwickeln. Bei der Mieterauswahl zählt nicht nur die Bonität, und genau dieses Urteil lernst du bei uns.
  • Du bist gut organisiert. Mehrere Objekte, Termine und Fristen parallel: Wer hier den Überblick verliert, verliert auch den guten Mieter.
  • Du arbeitest zuverlässig. Interessenten stehen sonst vor verschlossener Tür, und das kostet uns beim Eigentümer mehr als jeder Fehler im Exposé.
  • Du fragst nach, statt zu raten — bei Kunden genauso wie im Team.
  • Du bist eingeschrieben oder suchst eine Teilzeitstelle. Die Studienrichtung ist zweitrangig, kaufmännisches oder immobilienwirtschaftliches Interesse hilft.
  • Du lernst Software schnell und denkst digital.

Vorerfahrung in der Immobilienbranche brauchst du nicht. Das Handwerk bringen wir dir bei.


Was wir dir bieten

  • Einarbeitung. Du läufst mit, bekommst deine Aufgaben schrittweise und arbeitest ab dem ersten Tag mit jemandem zusammen, den du alles fragen kannst.
  • Aufgaben, die dich weiterbringen. Du machst keine Ablage und keine Kaffeeküche, sondern Arbeit, die im Lebenslauf etwas bedeutet und die du im nächsten Bewerbungsgespräch erklären kannst.
  • Perspektive nach dem Studium. Wer bei uns lernt und liefert, bekommt eine Zukunft und nicht nur ein Zeugnis.
  • Persönliche Weiterentwicklung. Wohin du dich entwickeln willst, besprechen wir offen und regelmäßig — und wir sorgen dafür, dass du die Aufgaben und die Unterstützung bekommst, die dich dorthin bringen.
  • Gelebte Feedback-Kultur. Feedback ist das schnellste Werkzeug, das wir haben, um besser zu werden. Deshalb geben wir es sofort und nicht einmal im Jahr. Das gilt in beide Richtungen: Du bekommst ehrliche Rückmeldung — und wir erwarten sie genauso von dir.
  • Planbarkeit im Semester. Vorlesungszeiten und Klausurphasen stimmen wir im Voraus ab, statt sie zum Problem zu machen. Besichtigungen liegen ohnehin häufig am späten Nachmittag.
  • Modernste Ausstattung: Premium-Hardware, cloudbasierte Tools, papierlos.
  • e-Mobilität inklusive: internes E-Carsharing für Termine und private Erledigungen.

title: Fluidic System Engineer / Architect (m/f/d)
description:

As a full-time member of our Orbital Systems team in Munich/Germany, you will work on defining the architecture of fluidic systems for spacecraft propulsion and other functions, working closely with a multi-disciplinary team. We work on projects ranging from launcher propulsion systems to orbital refuelling systems.

We are seeking engineers with demonstrated expertise in fluidic systems. Candidates with 3+ years of relevant experience are encouraged to apply. We are also interested in more experienced professionals with 10+ years of experience in fluidic system architecture and leadership. The position level, scope, and compensation will be determined based on the candidate's experience and demonstrated impact.

Ideally, your experience includes:

  • Knowledge of space systems and subsystems
  • Propulsion systems architecture, including HTP and/or hydrazine/MMH
  • Propellants ground handling experience including safety requirements
  • Fluidic system simulations, with knowledge of ECOSIM / ESPSS, Simulink, Matlab
  • Familiarity with MBSE concepts and requirements engineering principles; ECSS
  • Strong analytical and communication skills
  • Hands-on mindset for hardware related activities
  • Proactive, structured, and able to work independently and in a team


We offer

  • Immediate and flexible start

  • Attractive salary
  • 30 days annual vacation and flexible working hours
  • Bike leasing, Jobticket and EGYM Wellpass
  • Complimentary beverages, company events, and professional development opportunities

title: Senior Mechanical Engineer  (f/m/d)
description:
eleQtron develops and operates full-stack quantum computers based on trapped-ion technology. Quantum computing is a new computing paradigm rapidly approaching commercial viability. Our unique approach combines laser-cooled trapped ions with microwave control and tailored magnetic fields. Our next-generation computing machines under development will be able to find solutions to problems that are out of reach today, thus enabling new innovative products and services for a brighter future.

About the Role:

We are looking for a highly experienced and technically strong Senior Mechanical Engineer (f/m/d) who can take ownership of complex mechanical designs from concept through detailed engineering, manufacturing, assembly, and validation.

This is a hands-on engineering role for someone with strong mechanical engineering fundamentals, extensive practical design experience, and advanced SolidWorks capabilities.

  • Develop robust mechanical designs for high-precision scientific and industrial equipment

  • Create and maintain high-quality SolidWorks parts, assemblies, manufacturing drawings, BOMs, and technical documentation

  • Perform tolerance analysis and define appropriate fits, interfaces, geometric tolerances, and dimensional requirements

  • Translate system-level requirements into clear mechanical requirements, interfaces, and manufacturable design solutions

  • Define manufacturing requirements and work closely with suppliers and Procurement on manufacturability, materials, tolerances, and quality

  • Develop, test, and improve prototypes and actively contribute to design reviews and technical decision-making

title: Senior Solutions Engineer (m/w/d)
description:
Beam AI builds self-learning AI agents and an organisational operating system where intelligence grows through autonomous discovery. We help enterprises evolve from AI-curious to AI-native with automation that delivers results today and learns to improve itself over time. Join us in shaping a future where AI continuously discovers, adapts, and makes work more meaningful. To learn more, visit https://beam.ai/.

About the Team

Beam’s AI Agent Deployment team sits at the intersection of AI, product, and client impact. We partner closely with customers to understand their workflows, design intelligent automation solutions, and ensure our agents deliver real business value. Our work spans workflow design, agent configuration, technical integration, and ongoing optimization. We collaborate with engineering, ML, and product teams to translate abstract problems into scalable, agentic systems that work in the real world. This is a high-context, high-ownership environment where Deployment engineers operate with autonomy, move fast, and shape both how Beam’s platform evolves and how our customers succeed.

About the Role

As a Senior AI Agent Engineer at Beam, you will play a key role in delivering enterprise-grade AI automations tailored to real business processes. You’ll work directly with clients to understand their requirements, break down complex workflows, and design prompt-driven agents that solve high-impact problems. You'll also support integration efforts with client systems and ensure smooth delivery from concept to deployment.

We’re looking for someone who thrives in a hands-on, fast-moving environment, with a strong technical foundation, programming skills, a process-oriented mindset, and a passion for AI. You should feel confident working with APIs, designing robust automations, and collaborating across teams to turn business needs into working solutions. If you enjoy working across clients, technology, and automation, and want to build things that work in the real world, this is the role for you.

Responsibilities

Your work will involve both prompt engineering excellence and close customer collaboration. You will be expected to:

  • Partner with enterprise customers to identify automation opportunities, gather requirements, and translate business problems into agent-powered solutions
  • Design and build agentic automations using Beam's Agent OS. This includes scoping workflows, engineering prompts, and configuring integrations
  • Manage delivery end-to-end: timelines, client expectations, and stakeholder communication across technical and executive audiences
  • Troubleshoot and iterate on live automations by diagnosing issues, refining prompts, and improving performance
  • Collaborate with product and engineering to scope features, surface platform gaps, and feed customer insights back into the roadmap
  • Act as a strategic advisor to clients on AI adoption, workflow automation best practices, and integration architecture

Requirements

  • 2-3 years in a client-facing technical role such as Solutions Engineer, Implementation Consultant, Deployment Engineer, Customer Engineer, or similar
  • Strong project management and communication skills. You can run delivery timelines, manage client expectations, and explain technical concepts clearly to both engineers and executives
  • Demonstrated prompt engineering expertise. You've systematically written, tested, and optimized prompts in production or near-production settings
  • Experience automating workflows with AI. You've used AI to automate real business processes, not just experimented in sandboxes
  • Solid API knowledge and integration experience. You're comfortable scoping and coordinating API-based integrations with external systems
  • Analytical, process-driven thinking. You can take a messy business workflow, break it into structured components, and design an automation approach

Nice to Have

  • AI/ML background or hands-on experience applying AI to business workflows
  • Experience in a fast-paced startup environment

How We Hire

  • Our process includes a case study where you'll work on a realistic automation challenge: designing an extraction prompt, building a project plan, and presenting your approach. We want to see how you think, not just what you know.

Benefits

At Beam, we’re building an environment where ambitious people can do their best work, with clarity, purpose, and room to grow. We’re thoughtful about what we build, how we work, and who we hire. The problems we’re solving are real. The systems we’re building are complex. And the people here care deeply, about craft, about speed, and about doing work that actually matters. You won’t find rigid hierarchies or endless process here. You’ll find high trust, high standards, and a team driven by curiosity, ownership, and long-term thinking.

Our culture is shaped by our values in action:

  • AI-native thinking: Every teammate thinks in agentic workflows, uses AI tools daily, and looks for leverage through automation. AI isn’t just what we build, it's how we operate.
  • Customer obsession: We build with urgency and empathy, speak to customers early and often, and measure success through their outcomes.
  • Speed as a habit: We ship fast, learn faster, and prioritise unblocking over perfection. We favour small experiments with tight feedback loops.
  • Leverage-focused execution: We hire high-impact players, invest in the 20% that drives 80% of results, and value candid feedback.
  • Highly aligned, loosely coupled: We align on outcomes, not tasks. You’ll work independently, but never in isolation.
  • Data-driven, human-guided: We seek clarity over comfort, speak up early, and use feedback to grow together.

If this sounds like the kind of work you want to do and the kind of team you want to grow with, we’d love to hear from you!

title: Creative Growth Lead
description:
Super44 is building the all-in-one AI platform for independent local businesses: cafés, pubs, restaurants, flower shops and boutiques. We are a small, pre-seed team working together in person from a house overlooking the Rhine in Bonn. We are hiring a Founding Creative Growth Lead to build an unmistakably human social presence and turn great stories into growth.

Tasks

Own Super44’s social strategy, brand voice and creative output.

Find the human stories inside independent businesses and tell them brilliantly.

Develop concepts, write, shoot, direct, edit and publish the work yourself.

Make merchants, customers and founders compelling on camera.

Build authentic UGC and creator formats.

Test platforms, formats, hooks and narratives quickly.

Study performance, iterate, and turn organic winners into paid campaigns.

Use the latest AI tools to elevate real footage without making it generic.

Over time, build and direct a creative team while remaining close to the work.

Requirements

You have exceptional taste, strong internet culture instincts and a portfolio that proves it.

You have personally made social or video work that performed — you did not only write the strategy or brief someone else.

You can find a story, make people comfortable on camera, shoot it, edit it and learn from the result.

You care about brand and feeling, but also understand performance, paid social and why creative works.

You use AI tools fluently without letting them flatten the work.

You are fluent in German and English.

You enjoy spending time inside local businesses and can earn an owner’s trust.

Most importantly, you love independent hospitality and want to help local businesses thrive.

Benefits

€65,000–€125,000 salary plus 0.4%–1% equity.

Unusual ownership in a founding role.

Direct influence on the brand, product and company from the beginning.

Real merchants, strong early traction and a pre-seed round already raised.

The opportunity to create category-defining work and eventually build the creative team.

An ambitious, high-intensity, in-person environment in Bonn with a team that takes health, trust and good intent seriously.

To apply, send us three pieces of work you are proud of. For each, explain your personal contribution, why you made it that way and what happened after it went live. Then tell us about an independent hospitality business you love and the first Super44 story you would create there.

title: (Senior) Associate Finance (m/w/d)
description:
Wer sind wir?

Gläser & Gehrmann — besondere Partner für besondere Herausforderungen. Wir sind eine Boutiqueberatung mit Sitz in Hamburg und einem zweiten Standort in Bremen und verbinden Mandate, wie man sie von den großen Häusern kennt, mit den kurzen Wegen einer kleinen Kanzlei. Unsere Kompetenzfelder liegen in den drei Bereichen Tax, Finance und Restructuring. Unser Profil liegt im interdisziplinären Zusammenspiel aus fachlichem Know-how und Inhouse-Kompetenz sowie im Restrukturierungs- und Insolvenzsteuerrecht — besonders in der Beratung mittelständischer und größerer Unternehmensmandate.

Aufgaben

Was gibt es zu tun?

Gemeinsam mit unserem Team unterstützt du mittelständische Unternehmen, Konzerne und Unternehmen in Sondersituationen bei herausfordernden Sachverhalten aus dem Bereich Finance. Auf diese Themen kannst du dich freuen:

  • Du unterstützt bei der Erstellung oder Beratung anspruchsvoller Einzel- oder Konzernabschlüsse.
  • Du berätst Unternehmen bei Fragen rund um die IFRS.
  • Du begleitest mit deiner Expertise auch Unternehmen in der Krise, gegebenenfalls in Sanierungs-, Restrukturierungs- oder Insolvenzfällen.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Unternehmensmandanten zusammen und unterstützt deren internes Rechnungswesen.

Qualifikation

Wen suchen wir?

Bei dir steht Finance für deutlich mehr als klassische WP-Themen wie die Jahresabschlussprüfung? Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen! Zusätzlich würden wir uns freuen, wenn du dich in den folgenden Punkten zumindest ein Stück weit wiederfindest:

  • Du konntest bereits erste Erfahrung in der Wirtschaftsprüfung oder rechnungslegungsbezogenen Beratung sammeln.
  • Du beschäftigst dich gerne mit herausfordernden Sachverhalten aus der internationalen Rechnungslegung, Konsolidierung oder Berichterstattung.
  • Du möchtest mehr als einen klassischen 0815-Job in der Wirtschaftsprüfung.
  • Du stehst neuen Technologien offen gegenüber und hast keine Angst vor Veränderungen.

Benefits

Was bieten wir?

Gute Arbeit wissen wir zu schätzen. Dementsprechend kannst du dich auf ein erstklassiges Grundeinkommen mit einem attraktiven Vergütungsmodell und Aufstiegschancen freuen. Das ist aber noch lange nicht alles:

  • Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten mit direktem Mandantenkontakt und engagierten Karrierementoren.
  • Beste Rahmenbedingungen mit top Hard- und Softwareausstattung (DATEV, Office 365, Cloud, Laptop, Diensthandy) — damit die Arbeit gut von der Hand geht.
  • Übernahme sämtlicher Fort- und Weiterbildungskosten und aktive Unterstützung beim Berufsexamen — auch zeitlich und finanziell.
  • Eine Ermöglichungskultur, in der du dein Arbeitsumfeld von Beginn an mitgestaltest.
  • Regelmäßige und abwechslungsreiche Teamevents — unser Teamspirit will gepflegt werden.
  • Attraktive Nettolohnoptimierung (Benefits Card, Erholungsbeihilfe, Internetpauschale) — für mehr Netto vom Brutto.
  • Erstklassiges Grundeinkommen mit attraktivem Vergütungsmodell.
  • Büro und mobiles Arbeiten gehören bei uns selbstverständlich zusammen. Als Beratung mit hohem Projektanteil sind wir kein Nine-to-five-Betrieb — Mehrarbeit wird ausgeglichen oder im Jahresbonus berücksichtigt.

Wie bewirbst du dich?

Bewerben in drei Minuten? Kein Problem. Bewirb dich unkompliziert mit wenigen Klicks. Wir melden uns kurzfristig bei dir und freuen uns auf ein erstes Kennenlerngespräch.

description:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

🏡 Where you'll fit in:
KrakenFlex is the flexibility arm of the Kraken group, built to put a big green dent in global carbon emissions by rewriting how electricity grids operate. We stabilize the grid and help renewables come online much faster by managing the second-by-second balance of clean power. Right now, our platform connects nearly one million assets worldwide, putting over 6GW of live load under our direct control.

Behind the scenes, that means handling massive technical scale: solving complex optimization problems in real time and processing 15 billion data readings a day from the latest green technologies, ensuring the grid stays reliable without relying on old fossil-fuel backup plants.

The next phase of our journey involves monumental growth. Currently operational across multiple countries, we are poised for further global expansion, scaling our asset base and tackling unique grid challenges in new territories. Our mission is to integrate an increasingly diverse array of green flexibility assets while ensuring our market-leading platform remains exceptionally stable and performant.

What is Optimisation in Flex?
The Optimisation chapter is the mathematical and algorithmic engine of the KrakenFlex platform. While other chapters manage physical asset connectivity or ingest market signals, this domain is responsible for the intelligence that decides exactly what every asset should do, second by second, to maximise both grid stability and financial returns.

The teams within this chapter build and maintain the real-time dispatch engines, predictive forecasting models, and algorithmic solvers that handle massive multi-asset portfolios. This involves translating complex market rules, physical asset constraints (like battery degradation curves, state-of-charge limits, and ramp rates), and fluctuating price signals into optimised execution strategies.

The core tension lies in balancing the demand from data science and quantitative engineering to introduce increasingly sophisticated models with the strict platform requirement for absolute reliability, low latency, and cost-effective cloud compute.

Ultimately, this chapter must move away from bespoke optimisation routines tailored to individual markets or asset types. They manage managers and senior individual contributors, helping teams own their product surfaces, make sound trade-offs, and deliver reliably.

title: Senior Data Scientist - Business Operations
description:
About Deliveroo

Our mission is to transform the way people shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders. We are a technology-driven company at the forefront of one of the most rapidly expanding industries in the world: a complex, always-on, three-sided marketplace that impacts millions of people every day.

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

The Team

BizOps is the team that keeps its finger on the pulse of business performance: continuously, rigorously, and across multiple dimensions at once. We turn raw operational and financial data into actionable intelligence, surfacing what is happening, why it is happening, and what to expect next, for the operators, executives, and functional teams who run the business day to day.

We are not a reporting function that produces outputs on request. We work continuously, proactively watching, delivering, and questioning whether the signal is real, acting as "first responders" to surprising deviations from expectation and using what we learn to drive faster, better decision-making for the business at large.

Our work spans the full stack of analytics: from the warehouse models that make metrics trustworthy, to the monitoring systems that catch problems early, to the reports and dashboards that make performance visible, to the deep-dive investigations that explain what the numbers mean and what we should do about it.

We anchor our analysis to the right reference points: how performance compares to plan, to prior periods, and to what we'd expect, and we bring causal rigour when the business needs to know whether an action actually worked.

The culture within the team is informal, fast-paced and entrepreneurial. Given the growth of the business and the level of senior stakeholder exposure, progression in the team can be fast.

The Role

Deliveroo is hiring a Senior Data Scientist to join BizOps, based in our London HQ (hybrid, minimum three days per week in the office).

This role is largely project-based: starting from a strategic or performance question, you'll combine data, business context, and structured problem-solving to provide the insights that drive decision-making at a global level with senior stakeholders. You will own delivery end-to-end, from the messy, ambiguous question to a rigorous, trustworthy, and actionable answer.

You'll be equally comfortable building the systems that make performance visible and going deep on the investigations that explain it. One week you might diagnose why a key market has moved away from plan; the next, identify the drivers behind a change in customer or operational performance; the next, build monitoring that helps teams spot and understand emerging issues earlier.

Success in this role requires building effective working relationships across Deliveroo, particularly with international markets, as well as the Data Science, Operations, Commercial, and Finance teams.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Answer the questions that matter, continuously. Maintain a rigorous view on business performance: Are we on track against our goals? What's changed? How does this compare with what we expected? What should we expect next? Then go further: Why is it happening, what matters most, and what should we do about it?”

  • Own delivery end-to-end. Independently identify, define, and deliver impactful work aligned with business goals, operating with minimal guidance to ship fast, high-quality solutions.

  • Navigate ambiguity. Deconstruct broad, ambiguous problem spaces into structured analytical roadmaps, and understand how your work intersects with adjacent systems and teams.

  • Build for scale, not one-offs. Build the pipelines, models, dashboards, monitoring, and investigative tooling that make performance visible and reliable. Automate wherever possible; redoing analyses by hand is slow and error-prone.

  • Measure impact with discipline. Design measurement strategies from simple A/B tests to quasi-experimental designs (synthetic control, difference-in-differences, event studies) when trials aren't feasible, always with conservative, assumption-explicit language.

  • Be a first responder. Surface deviations before they become escalations, and be just as willing to give the confident "this is noise, no action needed" as the alarm.

  • Communicate to influence. Translate complex findings into clear, simple, actionable recommendations for both technical and non-technical audiences that shape roadmaps and decisions.

  • Raise the bar. Contribute to the broader Analytics community, improve shared approaches and best practices, and help build data literacy across the business.

What You'll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate brings strong expertise in some of these areas and the curiosity to grow in others:

  • Experience in an analytical or data science role, such as data analytics, data science, forecasting, planning, strategy analytics, or a similar discipline. Experience in logistics, e-commerce, marketplaces, or another fast-moving, customer-focused business is useful but not essential.

  • Proficiency with SQL and a scripting language such as Python or R, alongside experience with BI or visualisation tooling such as Looker, Tableau, or similar.

  • Comfortable using modern AI-assisted tools to work efficiently while maintaining high standards of accuracy and reproducibility.

  • A pragmatic approach to problem-solving: you can balance analytical rigour with speed, adapt your approach to the importance of the decision, and focus effort where it will have the greatest impact.

  • Effective problem-solving: you can take an ambiguous question, identify the underlying problem or decision, develop hypotheses, and use data and business context to reach a clear point of view.

  • Experience with experimentation and/or causal inference is a strong plus: the ability to unpick insights and steer strategic decisions.

  • Excellent communication skills, in person, in writing, and in code, with the ability to translate business needs into analytical problems and complex findings into simple recommendations.

  • Driven, hard-working, and agile. BizOps sits at the centre of a fast-growing business; we move quickly to scale at pace.

  • London-based, with a minimum of three days per week in the office.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving.

  • 🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale: work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.

  • 🌱 See your impact, fast: ship, test, and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment.

  • 🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership: take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.

  • 🌎 A culture built for builders: high standards, collaboration, flexible working, and continuous learning.

  • 💰 Share in the success you help create: competitive salary and equity, so you're rewarded for the impact you make.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine; our interview typically includes 3 to 4 stages.

Workplace & Benefits

At Deliveroo we know that people are the heart of the business and we prioritise their welfare. Benefits differ by country, but we offer many benefits across areas including healthcare, well-being, parental leave, pensions, and generous annual leave allowances, including time off to support a charitable cause of your choice. Benefits are country-specific; please ask your recruiter for more information.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we believe a great workplace is one that represents the world we live in and how beautifully diverse it can be. That means we have no judgement when it comes to any one of the things that make you who you are: your gender, race, sexuality, religion, or a secret aversion to coriander. All you need is a passion for (most) food and a desire to be part of one of the fastest-growing businesses in a rapidly growing industry.

We are committed to diversity, equity and inclusion in all aspects of our hiring process. If you have a disability or long-term health condition, or require any reasonable adjustments to apply or fairly participate in the interview process, please let us know; we'll make every effort to ensure you have an equitable opportunity to succeed.
