About Radiant

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built. We design and operate AI-native infrastructure platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale — powering GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems for the most demanding environments. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure from powered land, to compute, to software.

As we scale our operations and deploy capital into the next generation of AI infrastructure, we're building out our governance, risk and compliance capability with people who enjoy creating structure from scratch and are driven to build.

Radiant was established by Brookfield, a leading global alternative asset manager with over US$1 trillion of assets under management across real estate, infrastructure, renewable power and transition, private equity and credit. Brookfield's global relationships, investment expertise and access to long-term institutional capital provide Radiant with a differentiated platform from which to develop, finance and operate AI infrastructure assets. This combination of entrepreneurial execution and institutional sponsorship enables Radiant to pursue large-scale GPU and AI infrastructure opportunities globally.

About the Role

We're building out a dedicated Governance, Risk & Compliance function — moving from a mix of individual ownership and external consultancy support to a resourced team that scales with the business. As GRC Analyst, you'll project manage our compliance programme end-to-end, working alongside a Principal Security Engineer who owns the technical security posture.

This is a builder's role. You won't be inheriting a mature, fully-documented programme — you'll be creating and automating the processes, evidence trails and tracking that don't fully exist yet. You'll have senior guidance close at hand, both internally and through Brookfield's governance frameworks, but you're the one who makes the programme run day to day.

As Radiant's obligations grow — spanning business continuity, AI governance, and an expanding footprint into owned and operated data centre and powered-land infrastructure — this role will grow with them.

What You'll Do

  • Own end-to-end project management of the compliance programme: support ISO 27001 / SOC 2 audits, manage the policy lifecycle, and handle customer security questionnaires and KYC onboarding

  • Manage data protection operations and training, with UK GDPR at the core

  • Build and continuously improve how we work — automate manual, currently ad hoc processes (evidence collection, policy tracking, questionnaire responses) rather than running them from scratch each time

  • Coordinate business continuity: BCP/DR obligations and ownership of the Major Incident process, including testing and evidencing

  • Support our AI governance work — our internal AI and engineering AI policies — and help us keep pace with a fast-moving regulatory backdrop (including the EU AI Act), covering data handling, human oversight and vendor assessment

  • Coordinate health & safety compliance as we expand into physical premises and data centre operations, helping build a proper H&S management system where none currently exists

  • Partner closely with Finance and Engineering/Technology leadership, particularly on KYC, Anti-Bribery & Corruption (ABC) evidence, and technical control documentation

  • Help benchmark and align our Code of Conduct and policies with Brookfield's

  • Contribute to the wider roadmap as our footprint grows: precious and conflict-minerals due diligence, export controls, and ESG/energy governance

What You'll Bring

  • Solid UK GDPR and data protection experience

  • Genuine curiosity about how controls actually work — you're not satisfied when "the box is ticked," you want to understand the journey behind it

  • Hyper-organised — you can run multiple concurrent workstreams (audits, questionnaires, training, policy updates) without anything slipping

  • A builder's mindset — comfortable creating and automating a process from nothing, not just following an existing playbook

  • Autonomous and idea-driven — you'll be directed on priorities, not micromanaged on approach

  • Mid-level compliance/GRC/information security experience — your background does not need to be from AI infrastructure, data centres, or a related industry

  • Confident stakeholder management — you'll work directly with Finance and Engineering/Technology leadership, not just within a compliance team

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to ISO 27001 or SOC 2 audit cycles

  • Exposure to business continuity or major incident processes

  • Familiarity with AI governance or emerging AI regulation

  • Interest in health & safety, environmental/ESG reporting, or physical security and facilities governance

  • Experience with GRC tooling (e.g. Vanta or equivalent)

Why Join Radiant?

  • Competitive compensation including company-wide share scheme, bonus, travel paid

  • Real ownership of a function you're building from the ground up, with senior support rather than senior oversight

  • Work at the forefront of the AI infrastructure industry, at the intersection of power, compute and capital

  • Backed by Brookfield — genuine resources, mentorship, and room to grow the role as the company scales

Customers who select the package commit to 11 monthly payments for the Accounting Service, with those payments remaining due under the customer agreement, whether or not the customer completes the accounting onboarding process.

Your job is straightforward: ensure contractual monthly payments are collected, missed payments are followed up on promptly, and arrears are resolved consistently and professionally.

  • Design, document, and own the end-to-end credit control and collections process.

  • Establish clear escalation routes for unresolved arrears and recommend when accounts should move to the next stage of recovery.

  • Maintain accurate records and provide management with clear reporting on arrears, collections, recovery rates, failed payments and reasons for non-payment.

  • Identify opportunities to improve payment recovery through better communications, processes, automation and payment-retry workflows.

What We’re Looking For

You will need strong hands-on experience in credit control, collections, or recurring payment recovery, ideally within a subscription, professional services, or other high-volume customer environment.

Just as importantly, we’re looking for someone who can build a collections function rather than simply inherit one.

You should be:

  • An excellent written communicator who can create clear, professional and effective customer communications.

  • Firm, persistent and commercially minded while maintaining a professional approach to customers.

  • Highly organised and able to manage a large number of accounts, follow-ups and escalation actions.

  • Comfortable using finance, CRM or payment systems and Excel/Google Sheets for tracking and reporting.

  • Experience in accounting, bookkeeping or financial services would be useful but is not essential. Strong collections experience and the ability to build an effective process are more important.

  • A CICM qualification, or progress towards one, would be welcome but is not essential.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package

  • Hybrid working

  • Genuine opportunities for progression as the Accounting Service and wider business grow

description:
About Flock

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.

We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.

We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

 

About the role

More fleets are choosing Flock and our Customer Success team needs to grow. You will own a book of customers outright: onboarding them, keeping them engaged with their data, and getting them to renewal in better shape than they started. The role is built around the conversations our telematics makes possible, from quarterly reviews with fleet managers to safety interventions that follow a spike in risky driving, alongside a steady variety of inbound queries by phone and email. You hear first hand what matters to customers and brokers, and your suggestions for improving how we work carry real weight. AI is part of the day job too, because Flock runs on it. You will use it to prepare for meetings, dig into fleet data and stay on top of your book. You do not need insurance experience. What you'll be doing

  • Running quarterly reviews with fleet managers and brokers, then tracking the actions that come out of them, and supporting broker onboarding with the Distribution team

  • Delivering safety and claims interventions when our telematics data flags a risk, working with the Claims and Underwriting teams on triggers and follow-up

  • Working across Underwriting, Finance and Product to investigate and resolve the trickier issues, including policy referrals and connectivity troubleshooting with our telematics partners

  • Capturing customer feedback and raising process, automation and self-serve suggestions so our service keeps improving

  • Using Flock's AI tools every day to prepare customer insight packs, draft follow-ups and keep your book organised

 

What you'll need

  • A background in customer service, customer success or account management. The sector does not matter to us; the quality of your service does

  • Rapport that comes naturally. Our customers should genuinely like dealing with you

  • Hunger to learn and real coachability. We will teach you the insurance and the telematics

title: Software Engineer (Data)
description:
Our Mission

We’re not your average benefits platform – we’re the driving force that uplifts people’s lives. Our technology connects the entire benefits ecosystem, creating better outcomes for employers, employees, brokers, and providers.

Our mission is clear: to build a world where everything works at its best, ensuring every employee gets the support they need to thrive—both at work and beyond.

Your Mission

As our Software Engineer (Data), you’ll build and run the pipelines, orchestration, and infrastructure that move data across Ben: in from our product and the tools we use, in from our customers, and back out to them again. It’s the plumbing the whole company and our customers depend on, and it has to stay reliable. We serve global enterprise customers with strict security and reliability requirements.

You’ll own real work from day one. You’ll have a strong team of cross functional engineers alongside you, room to grow into harder problems, and the freedom to do the job your way.

What you’ll be working on

  • Own everything that flows into Ben: build and maintain the ingestion pipelines that bring data into our warehouse, with Fivetran for managed sources and custom pipelines where we need them.

  • Keep everything running on time: own the orchestration that keeps data moving on schedule and recovers cleanly when something breaks.

  • Scale and manage our data infrastructure: build and manage our data infrastructure as code with Terraform, using mainly AWS services.

  • Connect Ben to every system our customers run: build enterprise-grade pipelines and connectors for our customers, bringing their data in, for example from HR and payroll systems, and getting accurate data back out to them, reliably and securely, even at the volumes large customers bring.

  • Build the data layer our agents act on: help connect our data to the AI agents and services we're building, including through MCP connectors, so they get the right context at the right time.

  • Shape what we build: work with product and other stakeholders to scope problems and agree on simple but scalable solutions.

  • Build it to enterprise standard: build to current security practice, for example the OWASP Top 10 and the AWS Well-Architected Framework.

Behind the scenes

Ben runs on Python 3, Django, PostgreSQL, and React, on AWS.

Our data platform today is built around Fivetran, AWS DMS or custom pipelines for ingestion, dbt for transformation, PostgreSQL on AWS RDS as the warehouse, and n8n or AWS Lambda for automation between systems. We manage our infrastructure as code with Terraform and use different AWS services depending on requirements.

We have adopted frontier level agentic development practices and continue to push the envelope of what’s possible with current technologies.

Your skills and experience

  • Strong experience with Python and SQL.

  • A few years building and running production data pipelines that other people relied on.

  • Comfortable with infrastructure as code, ideally Terraform, and hands-on with AWS, for example Lambda, ECS, Glue, S3, RDS.

  • Experience building or running data integrations and connectors, especially ones that other companies or customers depend on, is a real plus.

  • Solid software engineering fundamentals: clean code, sensible design, and tests you can rely on.

  • You keep security in mind when you build applications and configure infrastructure, and you know what enterprise customers expect of their data.

Nice to have, not essential:

  • Experience working on customer-facing data integrations such as HRIS or payroll feeds via SFTP and in EDI format

  • Experience with MCP server development, or different ways of preparing data for AI agents such as ontology modelling, context, knowledge graphs, and semantic layers.

We don't expect all of it. We do expect curiosity about it.

Why join us?

Ben's customers are large enterprise employers, and the hundreds of thousands of people who work for them rely on us to get their benefits right, every time. That depends on data moving accurately between their systems and ours, every cycle. You get to work on the data infrastructure that makes this run like clockwork.

At the same time, Ben is an AI-native organisation. Agents are already doing a lot of impactful work here, and they can only do it on data they can trust.
